description: When learners commit an individual answer to a conceptual question and then discuss their reasoning with peers, later independent answers to a new isomorphic question may improve, conditional on the question, group dynamics, instructor follow-up and an immediate horizon.
title: Peer Discussion

description: For learners who have already studied the material, a structured exchange in which each must explain to a peer and answer that peer's questions (tutoring, teaching a peer, reciprocal roles, peer assessment) is expected to raise each learner's individually measured achievement over studying alone, for explainer and helped alike; meta-analyses test peer tutoring against no tutoring and teaching against studying, while no claim tests the doses, role rotation or hand-over points.
title: Peer Learning

description: Where learners sharing one goal differ in prior knowledge, interests, access needs or preferred means, tailoring support, pace, problem contexts and means to each learner while the goal and criterion stay common is expected to raise engagement and, where tailoring rests on a diagnosis of responses, aligned achievement, though no claim in the wiki tests personalization as a whole against uniform instruction and tailoring to learning styles is contradicted.
title: Personalization
